arabic_text: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً
transliteration: rabbanaa laa tuzigh quloobanaa ba'da idh hadaytanaa. wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah.
english_text: Our Lord, cause not our hearts to stray after You have guided us, and bestow upon us mercy from Your Presence.
Lo! You, only You, are the Bestower.

arabic_text: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا إِنْ كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولاًَ
transliteration: subḥāna rabbunā. ʾin kāna waʿdu rabbina lamafʿūlān.
english_text: Glory be to our Lord for in fact the promise of our Lord immediately takes effect.

arabic_text: يَا وَلِيَّ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ بَيْنِي وَبيْنَ ٱللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ذُنُوباً لَا يَأْتِي عَلَيْهَا إِلَّا رِضَاكُمْ
transliteration: yā walīyya llāh. inna bayni wa bayna allahi ʿazza wa jalla thunuuban. lā yatī ʿalayhā illā riḍākum.
english_text: O vicegerent of Allah!( ) There stand between me and Allah the Almighty and All-majestic, sins that cannot be demolished except by attaining your satisfaction.

arabic_text: فَبِحَقِّ مَنِ ٱئْتَمَنَكُمْ عَلَىٰ سِرِّهِ وَٱسْتَرْعَاكُمْ أَمْرَ خَلْقِهِ وَقَرَنَ طَاعَتَكُمْ بِطَاعَتِهِ لَمَّا ٱسْتَوْهَبْتُمْ ذُنُوبِي
transliteration: fabiḥaqqi mani 'atamana-kum 'alá sirrihi. wa-istaraʿākum amr khalkihi waqarana ṭāʿatakum biṭāʿatihi lammā istawhabtum dhunūbī.
english_text: Therefore, [I beseech you] in the name of the One Who has entrusted you with His secret, assigned you to supervise the affairs of His creatures, and attached the obedience to Him with the obedience to you, to (please) endue me with the favor of absolving my sins

transliteration: wa kuntum shufa'aiy. fa'inni lakum mutiʿun.
english_text: and to be my intercessors, for I am obedient to you.

arabic_text: مَنْ أَطَاعَكُمْ فَقَدْ أَطَاعَ ٱللَّهَ وَمَنْ عَصَاكُمْ فَقَدْ عَصَىٰ ٱللَّهَ وَمَنْ أَحَبَّكُمْ فَقَدْ أَحَبَّ ٱللَّهَ وَمَنْ أَبْغَضَكُمْ فَقَدْ أَبْغَضَ ٱللَّهَ
transliteration: man ata'akum faqad ata'allah. wa-man ʿasākum fa-qad ʿasāllāh. wa man aḥabbakum faqad aḥabb allāh. wa man abghadakum faqad abghadallah.
english_text: He who obeys you has in fact obeyed Allah, he who disobeys you has in fact disobeyed Allah, he who loves you has in fact loved Allah, and he who hates you has in fact hated Allah.

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي لَوْ وَجَدْتُ شُفَعَاءَ أَقْرَبَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ مُحَمِّد وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ ٱلْأَئِمَّةِ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَجَعَلْتُهُمْ شُفَعَائِي
transliteration: allahumma inni law wajadtu shufa'aa aqraba ilayka min muhammadin wa ahli baytihi. al-akhyaari al-a'immati al-abraar. lajʿaltuhum shufaʿā'i.
english_text: O Allah, had I known interceders that are closer to You than Muhammad and his Household the virtuous and pious Imams, I would have chosen them as my intercessors.

arabic_text: فَبِحَقِّهِمُ ٱلَّذِي أَوْجَبْتَ لَهُمْ عَلَيْكَ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُدْخِلَنِي فِي جُمْلَةِ ٱلْعَارِفِينَ بِهِمْ وَبِحَقِّهِمْ وَفِي زُمْرَةِ ٱلْمَرْحُومِينَ بِشَفَاعَتِهِمْ
transliteration: fabiḥaqqihimu al-ladhī awjabta lahum ʿalayka. as'aluka an tudkhilanī fī jumlati al-'ārifīna bihim wa bihaqqihim. wa fī zumratil-marḥūmīna bi-shafāʿatihim.
english_text: So, [I beseech You] in the name of their Right that You have made obligatory upon You, (please) include me with the group of those who recognize their Right and them and with the assembly of those who are shown mercy owing to their (i.e. Muhammad and his Household) intercession.
Verily, You are the most merciful of all those who show mercy.

arabic_text: وَصَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ ٱلطَّاهِرينَ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيماً كَثِيراً
transliteration: wa ṣallā llāhu ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālih-i ṭ-ṭāhīrin. wa sallama taslīman kathīran.
english_text: May Allah send blessings upon Muhammad and his immaculate Household and send His thorough peace upon them.
Allah is Sufficient for us! Most Excellent is He in Whom we trust.
